ms.report:
Dear Milestone Reviewer, 
Please find out renewed submission: we took all your feedback and updated the submission. 
Please find the updated Version of SIREN following the link: https://app.xerberus.io/siren/dashboard
What has changed since the last time?
We added the Scam Wallet list. Please note that you will currently see only one scam wallet. However, this is not a mockup but a real scammer's wallet. More scammer wallets will be added over the next few weeks. You can also submit your own wallet and register as a victim. Once you are registered as a victim, our algorithm will pick up your case, provided there is at least one other person who has also been scammed by the same actor.
・Here a quick walkthrough the application: https://www.loom.com/share/c868a6e8b5d14fbf9fd3500239215c84
・You can find all the milestone mapped out together in GitHub: https://github.com/XerberusTeam/SIREN/blob/07425353feb7b2b3dff80dfe36f6e98f34bd96fb/SIREN%20Development/3%20-%20Siren%20Alpha.md
・You can find our API description here: https://xerberus.gitbook.io/documentation/apis/siren
・You can find a PDF document with our User Feedback Analysis here, including the next steps we will take to address it: https://docsend.com/view/cnnxtxh8fqtz8xhs
・Additionally, you will find a link to a livestream where we demonstrate a live case using an improved version of SIREN that will be published in September in response to our user feedback:https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1lPJqOWrnYQKb

ms.promise:
In this milestone, we widen the audience for SIREN and allow the wider community to start using it. Also, we intend SIREN to be a public infrastructure that projects can use across the entire ecosystem, including wallet providers and other analysis platforms. This milestone is entirely dedicated to external security audits. 
・As Xerberus SIREN aspires to be such a significant piece in the overall Cardano security architecture, having a security audit for SIREN is necessary.
・To achieve wider adoption of SIREN, a wider test audience must be gathered to use SIREN. While the alpha testers will be invited to test SIREN, we will also ensure that the public knows SIREN and call for the general Cardano audience to test the SIREN beta in this milestone.
